Name: Steins Gate Kurisu Maho and Leskinen mod
Author: MahoHiyajo
Description:
Steins;Gate characters pack (Including Kurisu, Maho and the freshly added Leskinen)
this is a follow up [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2214]for a previous mod we made of Makise Kurisu [/url]﻿and for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2246]the Maho mod[/url]

[How to Install]
> Download and extract file
> Copy the .xnb Files to Folder \Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits (rar is organized by folders so make sure to follow the "guide")

*if you want the name to change please move the general name file to content/data

You SHOULD ALWAYS backup original portrait files before installing the mod
